 "content": "from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = set()
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((color, cells))
    color, shape = max(comps, key=lambda z: len(z[1]))
    r0 = min(r for r,c in shape); r1 = max(r for r,c in shape)
    c0 = min(c for r,c in shape); c1 = max(c for r,c in shape)
    sh, sw = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    mask = {(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in shape}
    # Other colored objects with the same shape are also copies of the stencil,
    # not part of the color key.
    stencil_objs = []
    for col, cells in comps:
        rr0=min(r for r,c in cells); rr1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        cc0=min(c for r,c in cells); cc1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        if (rr1-rr0+1, cc1-cc0+1) == (sh,sw) and {(r-rr0,c-cc0) for r,c in cells} == mask:
            stencil_objs.append(cells)
    excluded = set().union(*stencil_objs)
    keycells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in excluded]
    kr0=min(r for r,c in keycells); kr1=max(r for r,c in keycells)
    kc0=min(c for r,c in keycells); kc1=max(c for r,c in keycells)
    key = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(kc0,kc1+1)] for r in range(kr0,kr1+1)]
    # The color key is a repeated strip: take its distinct sequence across the row.
    colors = key[0]
    if not all(row == key[0] for row in key):
        colors = [row[0] for row in key]
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    center2 = r0 + r1
    start = (center2 - len(colors)*sh + sh) // 2
    for i, col in enumerate(colors):
        for dy, dx in mask:
            y, x = start + i*sh + dy, c0 + dx
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x] = col
    return out
"
}
